thresholds.tau90_s6_rule: 90th percentile of s6 among dev baseline exams with y6 = 0 (S4 Q2 miss rule at 6 years)

shared_axes.axis_0_name: z-geometry (lung cut in z, real slices, z-stretch)
shared_axes.source: r2_shared.py fitted on all 7,336 dev main exams (never on z-fix or test data); s5_axes_freeze.py

hypotheses.name: z-fix moves Sybil's score materially
hypotheses.statistic: share of T5 exams with |lbar6(zfix) - lbar6(main)| >= 0.25 x sd_ref_lbar6_all_dev_main
hypotheses.population: T5: test z-fix variants of T1 to T3 main series with spacing/thickness <= 0.65 (all screens); exams with a recorded ratio of 0 have no z-fix row and are not in T5
hypotheses.test: one-sided Wald, participant-bootstrap SE (2,000 draws, seed 0); p = 0 (right side of the null) or 1 if the bootstrap SD is 0

hypotheses.name: z-fix lowers Sybil's score
hypotheses.test: one-sided Wald, participant-bootstrap SE (2,000 draws, seed 0); p = 0 (right side of the null) or 1 if the bootstrap SD is 0

hypotheses.name: z-fix changes the tau90 flag (in both directions: flags are lost and gained)
hypotheses.statistic: share of T5 exams with [s1(main) >= tau90_s1] != [s1(zfix) >= tau90_s1]
hypotheses.test: one-sided Wald, participant-bootstrap SE (2,000 draws, seed 0); p = 0 (right side of the null) or 1 if the bootstrap SD is 0

hypotheses.name: the kernel changes the tau90 flag in fewer than 5% of exams
hypotheses.statistic: share of T4 pairs with [s1(sharp) >= tau90_s1] != [s1(soft) >= tau90_s1]
hypotheses.population: T4: the 500 soft-kernel partners of T1 exams (and their main series)
hypotheses.test: one-sided Wald, participant-bootstrap SE (2,000 draws, seed 0); p = 0 (right side of the null) or 1 if the bootstrap SD is 0

hypotheses.name: shared axis 0 of `pooled` (z-geometry) carries the z-fix drop of Sybil's score
hypotheses.statistic: mean over T5 exams of [delta lbar1 with shared axis 0 set to the dev mean in every member] - [delta lbar1 as Sybil gives it]; delta = z-fix minus main; lbar1 = mean of the five member logits computed from the saved `pooled` through Sybil's own hidden_fc, ReLU and head; frozen dev axis (frozen_axes_pooled.npz), no refit, no outcome
hypotheses.test: one-sided Wald, participant-bootstrap SE (2,000 draws, seed 0); p = 0 (right side of the null) or 1 if the bootstrap SD is 0
hypotheses.source: step R, candidate C2 (RESULTS_R_dev.md section 6; r6_candidate.py); amendment A6

hypotheses.name: in real follow-up, Sybil's 1-year score jumps when a yearly screen changes between stretched and not stretched, beyond the form
hypotheses.statistic: b in the OLS fit delta lbar1 = a + b x delta stretched + c x delta F1 over pairs of consecutive yearly screens of one participant (T0->T1, T1->T2; main runs); delta = later minus earlier; lbar1 = mean member logit of the main run (saved logits); stretched = 1 if spacing/thickness <= 0.65 as recorded in the series geometry (a recorded ratio of 0, i.e. duplicated slice positions, counts as stretched, as on dev), else 0; F1 = the frozen form model's 1-year logit (results/l2_form_params.json); no outcome, no refit
hypotheses.population: test participants with two consecutive yearly screens among the T1, T2, T3 main runs
hypotheses.test: one-sided Wald, participant-bootstrap SE (2,000 draws, seed 0); p = 0 (right side of the null) or 1 if the bootstrap SD is 0; bootstrap unit = participant (a participant can give two pairs)
hypotheses.source: step R2, candidate C3 (RESULTS_R_dev.md section 9A; r7_more.py); amendment A6
hypotheses.partly_seen_note: protocol 10: an approximate version (logit of the L1 published score instead of lbar1, the stretch status from the public IDC metadata) is computable from the L1 test scores, the form and public metadata, so H7 is labelled 'partly seen' (the only one in the family). It was never computed: no L1 script reads spacing, thickness or stretch, and the L1 test scores have not been analysed since L1; L1 post hoc saw only the overall correlation of the test logits between T0 and T1 of the same participant (r = 0.61; lung_l1/posthoc/posthoc_sybil_vs_form.py), not split by stretch.

bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile; p from the Wald statistic (est - null) / SD of the draws; SD 0 -> p = 0 on the stated side, else 1

fallbacks: if T3 is not scored: H1, H2, H3, H5prime and H6 use the T5 rows of T1 and T2; H7 uses the T0->T1 pairs only (stated before the run)
if T4 is not scored, H4 is 'not evaluated' and counts as not confirmed
if no T5 row is scored, H1, H2, H3, H5prime and H6 are 'not evaluated' and count as not confirmed

if T2 is not scored (for example, the identity check on forghanishayan fails), H7 has no consecutive pair and is 'not evaluated' (counts as not confirmed); the z-fix hypotheses use the T5 rows of T1 (and T3 if scored)
a hypothesis that is not evaluated keeps its place in the Holm family (m stays the family size)
secondary: AUROC (participant bootstrap) of Sybil s1 (y1, all screens), s6 (y6, baseline), F1, F6, R-size, F+I (frozen parameters)
frozen A3 combination: (F+I + Sybil) minus F+I, y1 and y6
frozen U3 table: false alarms per 1,000 at the radiologists' test sensitivity for the call, Sybil, F, C, F+I
descriptive: z-fix and kernel statistics by stretch class, lung cut and maker; group shares of all terms
flags in both directions (z-fix in T5 and kernel in T4): flagged in each run, flags lost, flags gained, share of discordant flags among exams flagged in either run
z-fix change of every term of lbar1 (N, T, mixed, unreplicated, intercept, residual) and the part of the mean shift carried by each
old H5 of the first freeze: Cov(G_T, lbar1) / Var(lbar1) on all main exams (near-automatic; review)

H6 details: C1 = mean z-fix change of axis 0 in dev SD units (dev -2.740; null -2.0 stated, not tested); for each of the 11 frozen axes the agreement of the five members (mean pairwise r; how many reach 0.70), the z-fix change and the kernel change in dev SD units; share of T5 exams moving >= 0.25 SD (lbar6) with axis 0 off (dev 0.550); AUROC with axis 0 off, y1 and y6 (caution C6: dev flatters Sybil)

H7 details: b with axis 0 switched off (dev -0.094); the jump of axis 0 per stretch change in dev SD units (dev 2.29); same scanner model subset; group means (stretched to not, unchanged, not to stretched); flag flips by group; b with recorded ratio 0 counted as not stretched (dev +0.227); 'both screens without cancer within 1 year' sensitivity (uses outcomes; computed after the primary result is saved)

harm estimates in T5 (pre-stated, never a hypothesis): sensitivity at tau90_s1 (y1, all screens) and at tau90_s6 (y6, baseline screens) for the main and the z-fix run, exact (Clopper-Pearson) intervals, the paired counts and the bootstrap interval of the paired difference; AUROC of s_t for main and z-fix and their paired difference (participant bootstrap)

where Sybil looks (s6_attention.py; descriptive): slice attention within +-1 bin of the largest recorded nodule against shuffled nodule bins, peak within 1 bin, in-plane attention on the nodule's lung side; conventions frozen from dev (box order reversed; patient right = image left)

H5prime (moved to the secondary list by the lead): mean over T5 exams of G_T(zfix) - G_T(main) for lbar1; G_T = exact contribution of the 6 T-named raw-unit families (frozen dictionary and labels of the first freeze); dev {"est": -0.0566, "ci": [-0.059, -0.0541], "halves": [-0.0565, -0.0567], "random_choice_share_below_null": 0.597}
